game.name: BE CRUSHED BY A SPEEDING WALL

features:
Pandora hub is OK script for game speeding wall. Here are the features as of now:

"Delete Speeding Wall". It makes it so that you cannot die from speeding wall.
"Loop Trigger Speeding wall" This will attach you to the button so it keeps triggering speeding wall.
"Tp To End" This will make you autowin the game. If your are stuck, just jump.
"tp to Safezone" This will TP you to safezone in game so nothing can hurt you.

If you want me add anything else, just put it in the comments.



I tested this on JJSploit and solara, as of now they both working for this script.
